formal_statement: have x1 : PEqualNP.CircuitLowerBounds.Gate → Bool := fun (x1 : PEqualNP.CircuitLowerBounds.Gate) => (if x1.op.eval [Bool.false, Bool.false] = Bool.true then List.take (1 : ℕ) x1.inputs else x1.inputs).any fun (x2 : ℕ) => Decidable.decide (x2 = (6 : ℕ)); have x2 : Bool → (Fin (8 : ℕ) → Bool) → List Bool := fun (x2 : Bool) (x3 : Fin (8 : ℕ) → Bool) => [x3 (1 : Fin (8 : ℕ)), x3 (0 : Fin (8 : ℕ)), x3 (4 : Fin (8 : ℕ)), x3 (7 : Fin (8 : ℕ)), x3 (5 : Fin (8 : ℕ)), x3 (2 : Fin (8 : ℕ)), x2, x3 (6 : Fin (8 : ℕ)), x3 (3 : Fin (8 : ℕ)), x3 (1 : Fin (8 : ℕ)) || x2]; have x3 : (Fin (8 : ℕ) → Bool) → Bool := fun (x3 : Fin (8 : ℕ) → Bool) => x3 (0 : Fin (8 : ℕ)) && x3 (1 : Fin (8 : ℕ)) || x3 (1 : Fin (8 : ℕ)) && x3 (2 : Fin (8 : ℕ)) || x3 (2 : Fin (8 : ℕ)) && x3 (3 : Fin (8 : ℕ)) || x3 (0 : Fin (8 : ℕ)) && x3 (4 : Fin (8 : ℕ)) || x3 (1 : Fin (8 : ℕ)) && x3 (5 : Fin (8 : ℕ)) || x3 (2 : Fin (8 : ℕ)) && x3 (6 : Fin (8 : ℕ)) || x3 (3 : Fin (8 : ℕ)) && x3 (7 : Fin (8 : ℕ)) || x3 (4 : Fin (8 : ℕ)) && x3 (6 : Fin (8 : ℕ)) || x3 (5 : Fin (8 : ℕ)) && x3 (7 : Fin (8 : ℕ)) || x3 (7 : Fin (8 : ℕ)) && x3 (4 : Fin (8 : ℕ)); ∀ (x4 : PEqualNP.CircuitLowerBounds.Circuit), PEqualNP.MetaComplexity.FanInTwo x4 → x4.size ≤ (14 : ℕ) → List.countP x1 x4.gates ≤ (1 : ℕ) → (∀ (x8 : Fin (8 : ℕ) → Bool), x4.eval (x2 Bool.false x8) = x3 x8) → ∃ (x9 : Fin (8 : ℕ) → Bool), x4.eval (x2 Bool.true x9) ≠ (x3 x9 || x9 (0 : Fin (8 : ℕ)) || x9 (3 : Fin (8 : ℕ)))
plain_statement: Feed an AND/OR/NOT fan-in-two circuit on 10 inputs the list (x1, x0, x4, x7, x5, x2, b, x6, x3, x1 OR b): the parent's inputs relabelled, with b in the place of the parent's x6 and the parent's first gate x0 OR x6 as the tenth input. Count the gates reading wire 6 (a NOT only at its first input). With F' the edge function of the graph with edges 0-1, 1-2, 2-3, 0-4, 1-5, 2-6, 3-7, 4-6, 5-7, 7-4: a circuit of at most 14 gates with at most 1 gate counted that equals F' whenever b is false is wrong, at some input with b true, against F' OR x0 OR x3.
title: A step toward: Petersen graph minus a vertex: no AND, OR (fan-in two), NOT circuit with at most 15 gates and first gate OR(x_0, x_6) computes its edge function
